name: What should I ask a retail TI contractor before hiring them?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask before hiring a contractor for a retail tenant improvement in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask before hiring a contractor for a retail tenant improvement in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a retail TI contractor, ask about recent retail projects, local permit experience, landlord coordination, inspection management, and how they handle schedule changes and change orders. Retail work is different from generic commercial construction because opening dates, center rules, and permit timing can all affect the project. You should also ask who prepares submittals, how trades are coordinated, and whether the contractor has experience with the specific city and building type. The best contractor is usually the one who can explain the likely risks before construction starts and who has a clear process for keeping the project moving when plan check or field issues come up.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about similar retail projects, permit experience, landlord coordination, scheduling, change-order controls, and who handles inspections. A contractor with local retail TI experience is usually better prepared for city review, tenant allowances, and opening-date pressure.
